statement: For every finite plane triangulation G and every degree-three vertex v with neighbors a,b,c, the tetrahedral replacement H=R_v(G) defined in source.md satisfies tau(H)=min{tau(G),3/2}, with tau(K_n)=infinity; this includes the boundary case G=K_4.
contribution: A complete proof of the frozen exact law. It parameterizes the source paper's five gadget-separator cases to transfer every toughness level t<=3/2, proves that a toughness-minimizing separator of noncomplete G avoids v and therefore transfers with unchanged component count, and verifies both bounds separately for G=K_4. The inspected source proves only the threshold implication, and no global priority claim is made.
